urls.rationale: Article 3 'LOBBYISTS' — the lobbyist registration, reporting, and disclosure statute body (W. Va. Code §§ 6B-3-1 et seq.).
Article 1 — Short title, legislative findings, purposes, and construction/application of Chapter 6B (Ethics Act); definitions and scoping the lobbyist regime depends on.
Article 2 — West Virginia Ethics Commission powers, duties, and disclosure provisions; the Ethics Commission is the agency that enforces the lobbyist provisions of Article 3.

notes: Article-level TOC; pass 3 needed to enumerate section leaves under article-3 (and articles 1/2 for support definitions/penalties).
